# Neuctra UI

> Neuctra UI is a React component library for building SaaS dashboards and applications, styled with Tailwind CSS. This file indexes the documentation site for LLMs and AI coding assistants.

Docs home: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs
Full setup guide: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/full-setup
MCP server (AI tool integration): https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/mcp

## Getting Started

- [Overview](https://ui.neuctra.com/docs)
- [Full Setup Guide](https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/full-setup)
- [Theme Toggle](https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/theme-toggle)
